e.issue.dense.title: Stitches too dense for thread and fabric
e.issue.dense.detail: Spacing {spacing} mm: with No. {weight} thread on this fabric the preset asks for at least {limit} mm.
e.issue.facing.title: Fills sewing towards each other
e.issue.facing.detail: On stretchy fabric this fill and “{other}” push the fabric towards their shared edge: let the rows run the same way.
e.issue.zigzagOnly.title: Satin with zig-zag underlay only
e.issue.zigzagOnly.detail: Without contour underlay the satin's edge has nothing under it.
e.issue.contourOrder.title: Contour away from its shape
e.issue.contourOrder.detail: On knit the contour of “{shape}” is sewn right after “{shape}”, before the next section.
e.issue.narrowRows.title: Rows too close in the narrow part
e.issue.narrowRows.detail: The curved fill's rows come down to {d} mm (set {spacing} mm) around x {x}, y {y} mm.
